Street Kit.name: Street Kit
Street Kit.description:
🌃 You carry what someone who walks the city at night carries.

🎯 The kit of a night patroller, a would-be vigilante or someone who expects trouble on the way home.
⚖️ The mask, ties and flashlight are legal. Carrying the baton without good reason is illegal, and police who find it can confiscate it and charge you.
⚠️ A baton and a mask together near a crime read as vigilante or villain intent.
🪢 Tying someone up is legal only to hold a person caught in the act until the police arrive.

🎒 Starts with: Domino mask, Telescoping baton, Zip ties ×5, Flashlight
Street Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a simple eye mask, a collapsible steel baton, a bundle of heavy zip ties and a flashlight: the kit of a night patroller, a would-be vigilante or someone who expects trouble on the way home. The mask, ties and flashlight are legal. Carrying the baton without a legitimate reason is illegal: police who search the character confiscate it and can charge them, and a baton and a mask together near a crime read as vigilante or villain intent. Tying someone up is legal only when holding a person caught in the act until the police arrive.
